units.rawText: Ahh~

units.rawText: Hey, was that a new record for skips? Oi, did you see that, Thur...

spans.text: She subconsciously reaches for a place most familiar to her by her side, but her hands find no purchase.

units.rawText: ...How trite.
units.displayText: ...How trite.

spans.text: ...How trite.

units.rawText: She stands up. As she pats the dust off her clothing, she wishes that the same could happen for the melancholy hanging onto her heart.
units.displayText: She stands up. As she pats the dust off her clothing, she wishes that the same could happen for the melancholy hanging onto her heart.

units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: Bonneville, I was looking for you.
units.displayText: Bonneville, I was looking for you.

spans.text: Bonneville, I was looking for you.

units.rawText: Why are you on my other... whatever, it's not a big deal.
units.displayText: Why are you on my other... whatever, it's not a big deal.

spans.text: Why are you on my other... whatever, it's not a big deal.

units.rawText: Shale told you I was here, right? What brings you to my secret race track, Professor?
units.displayText: Shale told you I was here, right? What brings you to my secret race track, Professor?

spans.text: Shale told you I was here, right? What brings you to my secret race track, Professor?

units.displayText: Bonneville, I'm challenging you to a motorcycle race.

spans.text: Bonneville, I'm challenging you to a motorcycle race.

spans.text: Bonneville is blindsided by the proclamation, concealing her awkwardness with coughing and sarcastic remarks.

units.rawText: Cough, cough, cough, man, I didn't see that one coming. I thought the only option left at a time like this would be a confession.
units.displayText: Cough, cough, cough, man, I didn't see that one coming. I thought the only option left at a time like this would be a confession.

spans.text: Cough, cough, cough, man, I didn't see that one coming. I thought the only option left at a time like this would be a confession.

units.rawText: Professor, can you tell me why you're doing this?
units.displayText: Professor, can you tell me why you're doing this?

spans.text: Professor, can you tell me why you're doing this?

units.rawText: I paid a visit to Shale before coming. Learned about your history as a four-time champion before you came to Magrasea.
units.displayText: I paid a visit to Shale before coming. Learned about your history as a four-time champion before you came to Magrasea.

spans.text: I paid a visit to Shale before coming. Learned about your history as a four-time champion before you came to Magrasea.

units.rawText: Oh, so you heard about when I was a driver...
units.displayText: Oh, so you heard about when I was a driver...

spans.text: Oh, so you heard about when I was a driver...

units.rawText: One correction, former four-time champion... as you can see, I've given up the ghost on racing.
units.displayText: One correction, former four-time champion... as you can see, I've given up the ghost on racing.

spans.text: One correction, former four-time champion... as you can see, I've given up the ghost on racing.

units.displayText: Bonneville tosses forth the remaining pebbles, allowing them to sink into the chilling depths.

spans.text: Bonneville tosses forth the remaining pebbles, allowing them to sink into the chilling depths.

units.rawText: So, Professor, what makes your first reaction to challenge me?
units.displayText: So, Professor, what makes your first reaction to challenge me?

spans.text: So, Professor, what makes your first reaction to challenge me?

units.rawText: Wouldn't it be more normal to ask me for a signature or mock my current state?
units.displayText: Wouldn't it be more normal to ask me for a signature or mock my current state?

spans.text: Wouldn't it be more normal to ask me for a signature or mock my current state?

units.rawText: The red rider tries to wave off the challenge by obfuscating the topic, but the person before her slowly shakes their head, not intending to back down.
units.displayText: The red rider tries to wave off the challenge by obfuscating the topic, but the person before her slowly shakes their head, not intending to back down.

spans.text: The red rider tries to wave off the challenge by obfuscating the topic, but the person before her slowly shakes their head, not intending to back down.

units.rawText: Because there are some things I can only convey to you this way.
units.displayText: Because there are some things I can only convey to you this way.

spans.text: Because there are some things I can only convey to you this way.

units.rawText: Oh? What things, exactly?
units.displayText: Oh? What things, exactly?

spans.text: Oh? What things, exactly?

units.rawText: If I said them now you would most likely just scoff at it. Do allow me to hold onto them for a bit, and keep it as a mystery to be revealed during the race.
units.displayText: If I said them now you would most likely just scoff at it. Do allow me to hold onto them for a bit, and keep it as a mystery to be revealed during the race.

spans.text: If I said them now you would most likely just scoff at it. Do allow me to hold onto them for a bit, and keep it as a mystery to be revealed during the race.

units.rawText: Alright, alright, assuming that I'm actually interested in whatever you've got... Professor, you're serious about racing me?
units.displayText: Alright, alright, assuming that I'm actually interested in whatever you've got... Professor, you're serious about racing me?

spans.text: Alright, alright, assuming that I'm actually interested in whatever you've got... Professor, you're serious about racing me?

units.rawText: You should be more than aware of the difference between a human and a Doll, right?
units.displayText: You should be more than aware of the difference between a human and a Doll, right?

spans.text: You should be more than aware of the difference between a human and a Doll, right?

units.rawText: Yes. Even knowing that, I want to challenge you.
units.displayText: Yes. Even knowing that, I want to challenge you.

spans.text: Yes. Even knowing that, I want to challenge you.

units.rawText: Bonneville's interest is piqued.
units.displayText: Bonneville's interest is piqued.

spans.text: Bonneville's interest is piqued.

units.rawText: She looks the Professor up and down, acknowledging the fervor in their eyes.
units.displayText: She looks the Professor up and down, acknowledging the fervor in their eyes.

spans.text: She looks the Professor up and down, acknowledging the fervor in their eyes.

units.rawText: ...A Doll against a human? It's been ages.
units.displayText: ...A Doll against a human? It's been ages.

spans.text: ...A Doll against a human? It's been ages.

units.displayText: Bonneville mounts her bike with a flip, tossing a helmet towards the Professor.

spans.text: Bonneville mounts her bike with a flip, tossing a helmet towards the Professor.

units.rawText: So you agree?
units.displayText: So you agree?

spans.text: So you agree?

units.rawText: Yeah, sure beats tossing rocks into a pond here.
units.displayText: Yeah, sure beats tossing rocks into a pond here.

spans.text: Yeah, sure beats tossing rocks into a pond here.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, how many times have you driven in a motorcycle race before? Three times? Five times?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, how many times have you driven in a motorcycle race before? Three times? Five times?

spans.text: Speaking of which, how many times have you driven in a motorcycle race before? Three times? Five times?

units.rawText: Zero times. I'm not proud of it, but I can count on my hands the amount of times I've ridden a motorcycle.
units.displayText: Zero times. I'm not proud of it, but I can count on my hands the amount of times I've ridden a motorcycle.

spans.text: Zero times. I'm not proud of it, but I can count on my hands the amount of times I've ridden a motorcycle.

units.rawText: I asked Erika to teach me some driving techniques before I came here. I hope they come in useful.
units.displayText: I asked Erika to teach me some driving techniques before I came here. I hope they come in useful.

spans.text: I asked Erika to teach me some driving techniques before I came here. I hope they come in useful.

units.rawText: So your first opponent will be a former pro racing Doll... don't know whether to call you lucky or unlucky.
units.displayText: So your first opponent will be a former pro racing Doll... don't know whether to call you lucky or unlucky.

spans.text: So your first opponent will be a former pro racing Doll... don't know whether to call you lucky or unlucky.

units.rawText: But a race is a race. I've agreed, so I'll honor it to the end.
units.displayText: But a race is a race. I've agreed, so I'll honor it to the end.

spans.text: But a race is a race. I've agreed, so I'll honor it to the end.

units.displayText: I don't think I will. I want a race that leaves no regrets.

spans.text: I don't think I will. I want a race that leaves no regrets.
